decision: Chose sqlite_index: ADR 0008 (Accepted) says the report cache is a SQLite file and report data is never cached only in process memory, which rules out an in-memory LRU. Mira's 50 MB cache limit is a new constraint on later work, so I drafted it as a new ADR in mira-app. I did not implement anything or commit.

recorded.info: New ADR with Status Proposed, awaiting confirmation. It records Mira's rule that the report cache must never grow past 50 MB (the kiosk has 1 GB of RAM). It also records the choice of a SQLite index over an in-memory LRU, per ADR 0008.
